title: Cabinet clears bills to raise Lok Sabha seats by 50%, freeze delimitation till 2051
description: The Union Cabinet has given the green light to a new bill aimed at expanding the Lok Sabha from 550 to 850 seats. This legislation introduces a significant milestone—a one-third reservation for women in both the Lok Sabha and state assemblies, set to commence in 2029. Additionally, it proposes a uniform 50% increase in constituencies across all states, based on the 2011 Census.

title: Lok Sabha seat freeze is no longer linked to population stabilisation
description: The distribution of seats based on 1971 Census continued for 50 years for the reason that a readjustment would adversely affect the proportion of States that stabilised population. Population stability was a stated objective of the government. That link between population stability and Lok Sabha share has been removed in the 132nd Constitutional Amendment Bill

title: Bisleri in fresh trouble, after Goa FSSAI finds bacteria in West Bengal water sample
description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has initiated prosecution against Bisleri International over unsafe drinking water samples. Recent tests revealed coliform bacteria in samples from its West Bengal and Goa plants. FSSAI has restricted the sale of specific batches following these findings and intensified surveillance on packaged drinking water quality. The regulator aims to ensure compliance with food safety norms across the country.

By leveraging her pre-MBA savings alongside internship and part-time job earnings, she crafted a robust loan repayment plan. While some debated the logic of early repayment, many admired her strategic financial oversight. Rathore passionately conveyed the significance of attaining financial independence to explore diverse career paths post-graduation.

Using Optical Character Recognition technology, he has crafted an organized, user-friendly electoral database that promotes public engagement and research initiatives. This thorough dataset, while enhancing accessibility for voters, retains the integrity of the original documents with the Election Commission of India.

The company also reported significant gains in AI server revenue, which surged to $22 billion. Additionally, Dell experienced a robust AI backlog valued at $132.3 billion. Two men were arrested on suspicion of burglary and trespass after the incident. Here's where the historic royal property is located, its connection to the Wales family and a look inside its interiors.

title: 50% uniform seats increase, delimitation on 2011 census: What govt's new Bill proposes
description: In a pivotal move, the government plans to retract the initial Delimitation Bill, 2026, introducing noteworthy changes. The updated Delimitation (Second) Bill, 2026, proposes a 50 percent increase in parliamentary seats and aims to incorporate women’s reservation into the Lok Sabha and state assemblies. Moreover, the Delimitation Commission will utilize the most recent census data for necessary adjustments, striving for improved representation while retaining the current seat allocation among states.

title: Man sexually assaults 60-year-old woman inside Mumbai railway station washroom, arrested
description: In a shocking incident at Ghatkopar railway station, a 60-year-old woman was attacked in a washroom late Thursday night while with her daughter. The suspect, recorded by CCTV, entered the facility shortly before midnight. After reporting the assault, the woman helped authorities quickly track down the attacker, leading to the arrest of a 25-year-old man, Taslim Noor Mohammad.

title: New Zealand 'Earthship' built with 1,300 tyres and 7,000 bottles goes on sale
description: For sale in New Zealand's scenic Coromandel region, a distinct four-bedroom Earthship home composed of recycled tyres and glass bottles awaits new owners. This eco-conscious abode, featuring solar power and passive heating, was constructed in 2015 and has gained popularity following its showcase on Grand Designs New Zealand. Owners Gus Anning and Sarah Rowe are transitioning to the Bay of Islands, seeking individuals who will honor their sustainable dream.

title: Arizona court awards Phoenix home to estranged wife after 24-year dispute
description: After her husband's passing in September 2024, Rita Mack successfully retained her Phoenix residence. Dimica Hicks, who had cohabited with Troy Torrence for 24 years, contested this claim. However, the court reaffirmed Mack's ownership based on the original joint tenancy agreement. Although Hicks sought compensation for property expenses, her request was refused. Ultimately, the appeals court confirmed Mack's exclusive ownership and dismissed Hicks' allegations.

title: Study finds mothers of three or more children less accepting of young kids' anger
description: A recent study examined how a mother's number of children affects her acceptance of their negative emotions. Researchers surveyed 226 mothers in Portugal with children aged two to six years. Findings indicate that mothers with three or more children showed less acceptance of childhood anger compared to those with fewer children. This suggests larger family dynamics may challenge a mother's emotional responses to children's anger.

title: 'He will win games single-handedly': Ex-cricketer backs Sooryavanshi for ODI World Cup
description: Kris Srikkanth emphasized the potential of teenage cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for international formats. He urged the Indian team management to include Sooryavanshi in upcoming ODI series against Sri Lanka. Srikkanth believes that Sooryavanshi should be part of the 2027 ODI World Cup squad. He praised the young player's batting technique, comparing him to legends Sachin Tendulkar and Virat Kohli.

title: 'Pressure or political calculation?' Cong slams NCP-SP's move to back delimitation bill
UK net migration falls below 100,000 in dramatic post-Brexit shift, figures show
description: Net migration in the UK has plummeted to levels not seen since 1997, following a high of nearly one million new arrivals three years prior. The implementation of stricter immigration policies after Brexit, which raised salary requirements and restricted job sponsorships for migrants, has contributed to this notable decline. This reflects a broader shift in governmental strategies and responses to changing demographic trends.

title: No interim relief for Tata Trusts as Bombay HC refuses to halt Tata Sons board meet
description: The Bombay High Court has denied interim relief to Tata Trusts regarding the upcoming Tata Sons board meeting, scheduled for November 30. The court affirmed that this meeting will occur as planned. Tata Trusts are contesting the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as chairperson, citing the need for approval from their nominee directors, highlighting the ongoing power struggle within Tata Sons.

title: From Sachin Tendulkar to Rohit Sharma: All 10 MI captains and their records
description: After the trade of Hardik Pandya to Punjab Kings, Rohit Sharma is back as captain of the Mumbai Indians for the team's 20th IPL season. Since its launch in 2008, the franchise has cycled through ten captains. Rohit has achieved remarkable success, leading the team to five IPL titles between 2013 and 2023, underlining his significant role and accomplishments as a leader.

title: RBI lowers minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 99% to 90%
Union Budget 2027: Should government scrap LTCG tax and hike STT instead?
description: Proposals for the upcoming Budget 2027-28 focus on lowering or abolishing long-term capital gains tax. Industry bodies have differing views on changes to securities transaction tax that could replace revenue losses. SBI Research suggests raising the STT to offset losses if LTCG is abolished. PHDCCI, however, argues for halving the short-term capital gains tax while simultaneously reducing STT rates.

title: Meerut hotel worker arrested after video purportedly shows him spitting on rotis
description: A video allegedly showing a hotel employee spitting on a roti has gone viral on social media. The incident reportedly occurred during food preparation at the hotel located in Mahalka village. Police became aware of the situation and initiated an investigation into the incident shortly after it surfaced online. Authorities confirmed that the employee seen in the video has been arrested for his actions.

title: Rohit Sharma back as Mumbai Indians captain; five-time winner to lead team in IPL 2027
description: Rohit Sharma will return as Mumbai Indians captain for IPL 2027 following Hardik Pandya's trade to Punjab Kings. The five-time IPL-winning skipper, who was replaced by Hardik ahead of the 2024 season, returns to the leadership role after three seasons. Rohit, who joined Mumbai Indians in 2011 and took over the captaincy in 2013, will lead the franchise in its 20th season of the IPL, chasing a sixth IPL title.

title: 'Mr C Joseph hates Sanatan': BJP hits out at Vijay govt after SC's Deepam rebuke
description: The BJP has strongly criticized the Tamil Nadu government for failing to comply with a Supreme Court order. This issue arose from the dispute over lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon. Senior officials received contempt notices from the Supreme Court due to non-compliance with its directive. The BJP claims the government's actions have offended Hindu devotees and hurt their sentiments.

title: Major setback for UPPCS-2025 recruitment: HC quashes prelims result, orders fresh selection
description: The Allahabad High Court has instructed the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission to carry out a fresh selection process for UPPCS-2025. This directive arises from petitions submitted by reserved-category candidates who were barred from transitioning to the open category. Consequently, the ruling affects all results related to preliminary exams, mains, and interviews, with a new merit list to be formed based on criteria aimed at fostering meritocracy in recruitment.

title: Drone hits 'Dhurandhar' rapper Reble in face during performance at Guwahati award event
description: Rapper Reble was performing at the PULSE 2026 Awards when a drone struck her in the face. After being hit, she abruptly left the stage without addressing the audience or providing further information. Footage of the incident has circulated on social media, sparking concerns among fans and criticism of the event's organizers. Many users expressed worries for Reble's safety and called for better event management.

Chinese passenger travelling from Hong Kong held with knife concealed in waist belt at Delhi airport
description: On November 20, Delhi Airport security uncovered a concealed knife on a Chinese national arriving at the airport. Ingeniously hidden inside the buckle of a stylish black metallic waist belt, the knife was detected during X-ray scanning of the luggage. The passenger asserted that he had no knowledge of the weapon's existence, claiming his children had given it to him.

title: Home tuition allowed in Delhi but not city? Missing studies also cited
description: Kamal Rathi presented important public interest issues regarding Bhopal's Master Plan 2047 concerning climate change and home-based tuition. He recommended retaining provisions for professional services and questioned the proposed residential status of Hamidia Road. Concerns about the RG-5 classification affecting existing homeowners were also raised during the presentation. CREDAI representative Mayank Kapoor highlighted the lack of green building incentives within the draft plan.

title: Big win for Mamata: HC sets aside Ritabrata Banerjee's appointment as Bengal LoP
88-year-old father moves to old-age home; Bombay HC orders son to return gifted flat
description: In a significant ruling, the Bombay high court invalidated a gift deed that had transferred a flat to a son, following claims from the father that his son breached their maintenance agreement. The court affirmed the father's lifetime right to reside in the flat, noting that the maintenance terms were integral to the gift. The family has been instructed to vacate the premises within fifteen days.

title: Cabinet clears 50% increase in LS seats across states, ceiling to remain till 2051
Texas grants SpaceX permit as data center approvals start before Hinojosa’s term
description: SpaceX has obtained an air pollution permit for a natural gas power plant in Boca Chica, Texas. The plant is part of a larger supercomputing complex planned east of Brownsville. Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has promised to pause new data center developments and end tax breaks for the industry. Local authorities are set to discuss a property tax break for the project on December 9.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current support struggling families
description: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' Kansas City Current has extended its impact beyond soccer through community initiatives. In September 2024, the club partnered with Dairy Farmers of America, Harvesters and United Way to distribute 400 gallons of milk and fresh produce. The drive helped nearly 400 adults and children in Kansas City, highlighting the organisation's efforts to support local families facing food insecurity beyond the football field.

title: Jason Kelce’s real estate journey: From $680K home to $6 million estate
description: Jason and Kylie Kelce's Pennsylvania property expansion reflects their changing family needs as they raise four daughters. What began as a $680,000 home has grown into a nearly $6 million estate through multiple neighbouring property purchases. The couple wanted to remain in their existing neighbourhood while creating more space, privacy and security. Despite facing objections from neighbours, their plans highlight their desire to build a comfortable, stable environment for their children.
